build.//: Three profiles, and the difference between them is who can install the result.

development.//: A dev client: Metro drives it, Fast Refresh works, and it is how the app is worked on day to day.

preview.//: Standalone, with the JS bundled, installable from a link by anyone whose device is registered. This is what goes to somebody who wants to try it, and it needs no App Store and no review.

production.//: The store build. TestFlight for iOS, an .aab for Play — see docs/mobile.md on why TestFlight is a bridge and not a destination.
